title: Studio 154 Hotel - Duet Loft Suite
description: The Duet Loft Suite is one of Studio 154 Luxury Hotel's best accommodations. You'll step into a modern,  875 sq ft two-story loft style suite that sleeps up to 6 guests with an en-suite full kitchen.  With windows overlooking 2nd Ave North, This suite allows you to feel fully immersed in the nightlife of the city.  All guests also have access to the SKYDECK - rooftop with waterfront panoramic views of the Cumberland River and the Nashville skyline.
